title: Pope Leo Rides Popemobile Through St. Peter's Square at First General Audience Since Cancer Surgery
detail: Eight days after lung surgery, Pope Leo held his first general audience in St. Peter's Square, riding the open-air popemobile and blessing babies and pilgrims. America Magazine reported a strong voice and the Our Father sung in Latin; greetings were given in seven languages instead of nine. He did not mention the Nov 6 Latin America trip.

media.caption: Pope Leo on popemobile in St. Peter's Square

title: Doctors Say Pope Leo Needs No Further Treatment for Lung Cancer After Surgery
detail: Doctors said Pope Leo does not need further treatment for lung cancer following his surgery, according to SCMP.
